headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.3344). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.57 (95% CI: 0.18–1.81), indicating no statistically significant association between zinc and uterine cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 86.55%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
